emails.subject: Pilot outline for tomorrow
emails.preview_text: How monitors sit beside your existing tests
emails.body_text: Hi, ahead of tomorrow's call, here is the outline. Halden alerts the owning team within five minutes on schema drift and stale tables. [E1] It runs beside the table-level tests you already write. [E8] Can we agree the billing tables as the pilot scope?
emails.ask: Agree the billing tables as the pilot scope.

emails.subject: Where monitored data stays
emails.preview_text: A short note for your security review
emails.body_text: Hi, the Halden agent runs inside your own cloud account, so row-level data does not leave it. [E4] Connectors use read-only credentials. [E5] Could your team review the attached summary before Friday?
emails.ask: Review the attached data residency summary.

emails.subject: Proposed 60-day pilot
emails.preview_text: Scope, success measures and next steps
emails.body_text: Hi, thanks for the time. A regional water company cut incident triage from six hours to ninety minutes. [E2] We propose a 60-day pilot on the billing tables. [PLACEHOLDER: pilot success criteria] Shall we set a start date?
